question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH jan_jun_orders AS (
    SELECT USER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS order_count
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDERS
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
    GROUP BY USER_ID
),
jul_dec_orders AS (
    SELECT USER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS order_count
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDERS
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_jun_orders WHERE order_count > 1) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jul_dec_orders WHERE order_count > 1) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec;
action.metrics: repeat customers in Jan–Jun 2025, repeat customers in Jul–Dec 2025
repeat customers in Jan–Jun 2025, repeat customers in Jul–Dec 2025
action.answer: In January–June 2025, there were 95,048 repeat customers (users who placed more than one order in that period). In July–December 2025, there were 96,514 repeat customers (users who placed more than one order in that period). Repeat status was evaluated separately within each half-year. July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025.
